name: 连接池配置与优化诊断
description: 连接池是应用与 MySQL 之间的关键桥梁。配置不当会导致两种极端：连接池过小 → 获取连接超时、应用线程阻塞；连接池过大 → MySQL 端连接数暴涨、线程调度开销增大、内存浪费。合理的连接池大小通常远小于直觉预期：对于 OLTP 系统，每个应用实例 10-30 个连接通常足够。

root_causes.name: 连接池 maxPoolSize 过大
root_causes.desc: 应用端连接池设置过大（如 100-200），多个应用实例叠加后总连接数超过 MySQL max_connections。HikariCP 默认 maximumPoolSize=10，Druid 默认 maxActive=8，实际生产中经常被调大。正确做法：总连接数 = 单实例 poolSize × 实例数，不应超过 max_connections 的 80%。

root_causes.name: 连接泄漏
root_causes.desc: 应用代码未正确关闭连接（try-with-resources/finally close），导致连接池中的连接被借出后不归还。Druid 可通过 removeAbandoned=true 检测泄漏；HikariCP 通过 leakDetectionThreshold 告警。

root_causes.name: 慢查询占用连接
root_causes.desc: 慢查询长时间占用连接不释放，其他请求排队等待可用连接。连接池看似满了但实际是被慢查询阻塞。需要同时优化慢查询和设置合理的 connectionTimeout。

root_causes.name: 连接池 minIdle 过高
root_causes.desc: minIdle 设置过高导致空闲连接占用大量 MySQL 连接数。低峰期仍维持大量空闲连接浪费资源。

step1_connection_overview.sql: SELECT @@max_connections AS max_conn, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Threads_connected') AS current_conn, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Threads_running') AS active_threads, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Max_used_connections') AS peak_conn, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Connection_errors_max_connections') AS rejected_conn

step2_connections_by_host.desc: 按来源 IP 统计连接分布
step2_connections_by_host.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(host, ':', 1) AS client_host, user, COUNT(*) AS conn_count, SUM(IF(command='Sleep', 1, 0)) AS idle_count, SUM(IF(command!='Sleep', 1, 0)) AS active_count FROM information_schema.processlist GROUP BY client_host, user ORDER BY conn_count DESC LIMIT 20

step3_idle_connections.desc: 查找长时间空闲的连接
step3_idle_connections.sql: SELECT id, user, host, db, command, time AS idle_seconds, state FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE command = 'Sleep' AND time > 300 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20

step4_long_running_queries.desc: 查找占用连接的长查询
step4_long_running_queries.sql: SELECT id, user, host, db, time, state, SUBSTRING(info, 1, 200) AS query FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE command = 'Query' AND time > 10 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20

step5_connection_params.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('max_connections', 'wait_timeout', 'interactive_timeout', 'connect_timeout', 'net_read_timeout', 'net_write_timeout', 'thread_cache_size')

step6_connection_errors.desc: 查看各类连接错误统计
step6_connection_errors.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME LIKE 'Connection_errors%' AND VARIABLE_VALUE > 0

version_specific_notes.5.7: 线程缓存通过 thread_cache_size 控制。max_connections 默认 151。每个连接基础内存约 256KB + 各 buffer 配置
version_specific_notes.8.0: 新增 admin_port + CREATE_ADMIN_LISTENER 权限，管理连接不受 max_connections 限制。Performance Schema 连接统计更完善。支持 SET PERSIST max_connections
version_specific_notes.8.4: 连接管理优化，线程创建开销进一步降低。thread_cache_size 自动调整。支持更细粒度的连接统计

real_world_examples.scenario: 20 个微服务实例各配置 maxPoolSize=50，MySQL 频繁报 Too many connections
real_world_examples.symptoms: 高峰期 Threads_connected 达到 950（max_connections=1000），Connection_errors_max_connections 持续增长。应用频繁报 CannotAcquireConnectionException
real_world_examples.root_cause: 20 × 50 = 1000 个潜在连接数刚好打满 max_connections。实际监控发现 Threads_running 峰值只有 30，说明大部分连接是空闲的
real_world_examples.resolution: 将每个实例的 maxPoolSize 从 50 降到 15，minIdle=5。总连接数上限从 1000 降到 300
real_world_examples.result: max_connections 降到 500，Threads_connected 峰值约 200。应用响应时间反而改善（减少了 MySQL 线程调度开销）
